audit_metadata.title: Audit Reconciliation and Evidence Verification
audit_metadata.auditor: Independent Senior ML Auditor & Reproducibility Specialist
audit_metadata.recommendation: Stage 3.4.1 findings are mathematically verified with corrected hard-capacity boundaries. Synthetic Dataset v2.2 protocol is approved for generation upon explicit authorization.

claims_registry.description: Validation cohort size equals 12,129 orders
claims_registry.explanation: Exact match reproduced from saved validation labels and orders.csv filtered by TRAIN_END < date <= VAL_END.

claims_registry.description: Validation actual fraud count equals 854 orders (prevalence 7.04%)
claims_registry.explanation: Exact match reproduced. Positive prevalence is 854 / 12,129 = 0.0704098.

claims_registry.description: Confusion matrix at threshold t = 0.07: TP=424, FP=3285, FN=430, TN=7990, Flagged=3709
claims_registry.explanation: Exact match reproduced. True positives = 424, False negatives = 430, Total fraud = 854.

claims_registry.description: Conservation identities: TP + FN = Total Fraud, TP + FP = Flagged, TN + FP + FN + TP = Total Orders
claims_registry.explanation: All three conservation identities hold with zero discrepancy.

claims_registry.description: Expected operational cost at t = 0.07 equals $101,590 under C_FP=$10, C_FN=$150, C_TP=$10
claims_registry.explanation: Calculated cost FP*10 + FN*150 + TP*10 = 3285*10 + 430*150 + 424*10 = $101,590. Equivalence to Flagged*10 + Missed*150 = 3709*10 + 430*150 = $101,590 verified.

claims_registry.description: Internal textual wording consistency between cost-optimal cutoff and policy routing cutoff
claims_registry.original_reported_value: Passage 1: 424 true positives / 430 missed fraud ($101,590 at t=0.07); Passage 2: 422 intercepted fraud / 432 passed (at t=0.08)
claims_registry.reproduced_value: t=0.07 yields TP=424, FN=430; t=0.08 yields TP=422, FN=432
claims_registry.explanation: The text conflated the cost-optimal cutoff (t=0.07, 424 caught) with the 4-tier routing policy cutoff (t=0.08, 422 caught). The arithmetic for each threshold is correct, but imprecise wording created reviewer confusion.
claims_registry.remediation: Explicitly distinguish the unconstrained cost-minimizing cutoff (t=0.07) from the 4-tier discrete routing boundaries (ALLOW < 0.08, REVIEW >= 0.08).

claims_registry.description: Boundary operator definition: score >= threshold vs score > threshold
claims_registry.explanation: Implementation uses >=. In the validation cohort, exactly 0 scores equal 0.07, so >= and > yield identical confusion matrices.
claims_registry.remediation: Document score >= t as the formal boundary semantic.

claims_registry.description: Cost-minimizing threshold is uniquely t = 0.07 with zero ties in the sweep
claims_registry.explanation: Recomputed cost across all 80 grid points from 0.01 to 0.80. Minimum cost is uniquely $101,590 at t=0.07.

claims_registry.description: Original capacity selection algorithm enforced a hard upper bound
claims_registry.explanation: The original Stage 3.4 script selected candidate operating points by minimizing absolute distance to target capacity, allowing volume to exceed budget.
claims_registry.remediation: Replace with strict hard ceiling filter: volume <= floor(budget * N).

claims_registry.description: Stage 3.4 reported 5% capacity operating point (t = 0.13, 699 orders, 5.76% volume) satisfied capacity limit
claims_registry.explanation: Operating at t=0.13 sends 699 orders to review, causing a 15.3% queue overflow (+93 orders) beyond the 606-order ceiling.
claims_registry.remediation: Reject t=0.13 as non-compliant for 5% capacity.

claims_registry.description: Corrected 5% capacity operating point: threshold t = 0.15 flags 477 orders (3.93% volume) catching 99 frauds
claims_registry.explanation: Under strict integer ceiling floor(0.05 * 12129) = 606 orders, t=0.15 is the maximum-recall operating point strictly obeying the hard budget.
claims_registry.remediation: Adopt t=0.15 as the verified 5% capacity operating point.

claims_registry.description: Corrected 1% capacity operating point: threshold t = 0.20 flags 41 orders (0.34% volume) catching 15 frauds
claims_registry.explanation: Under ceiling floor(0.01 * 12129) = 121 orders, t=0.20 flags 41 orders <= 121. Due to discrete step jumping from 41 to 477, 41 is the maximal compliant volume.

claims_registry.description: Corrected 2% capacity operating point: threshold t = 0.20 flags 41 orders (0.34% volume) catching 15 frauds
claims_registry.explanation: Under ceiling floor(0.02 * 12129) = 242 orders, t=0.20 is the highest achievable volume <= 242 because next step has 477 orders.

claims_registry.description: Corrected 10% capacity operating point: threshold t = 0.11 flags 1,111 orders (9.16% volume) catching 185 frauds
claims_registry.explanation: Under ceiling floor(0.10 * 12129) = 1212 orders, t=0.11 flags 1,111 orders <= 1212. Next threshold step flags 1,545 orders.
claims_registry.remediation: Adopt t=0.11 as the verified 10% capacity operating point.

claims_registry.description: Validation ECE = 0.0000 achieved by Isotonic Calibration proves perfect calibration
claims_registry.explanation: ECE = 0.0000 is an in-sample artifact of PAVA step blocks aligning within 10 uniform bins on the fitting data. Out-of-sample diagnostic test ECE is 0.0282.
claims_registry.remediation: Classify validation ECE as IN_SAMPLE_FIT_COHORT and disallow using it as proof of out-of-time calibration.

claims_registry.description: Diagnostic test calibration: out-of-sample test ECE equals 0.0282 (Late Fusion) and 0.0289 (Tabular-Only)
claims_registry.explanation: Exact reproduction matches 0.0282. Reflects true out-of-sample probability alignment.

claims_registry.description: Binning behavior: 6 out of 10 uniform bins are completely empty
claims_registry.explanation: Maximum predicted calibrated probability is 0.4444 on validation, leaving upper bins unoccupied.

claims_registry.description: Score joins between orders and listings are complete with zero row drops or duplicates
claims_registry.explanation: All 12,129 validation orders and 20,919 test orders join cleanly via listing_id. Zero missing listing IDs.

claims_registry.description: Correlation between order fraud risk and listing fraud risk is positive (r = 0.2533, rho = 0.2448)
claims_registry.explanation: Moderate positive correlation reproduced exactly.

claims_registry.description: Conditional independence assumption of Noisy-OR is violated
claims_registry.reproduced_value: Independence violated linearly (r > 0) and non-linearly (syndicate co-occurrence)
claims_registry.explanation: Common syndicate actors operate fraudulent listings and compromised buyers simultaneously, violating P(not A and not B) = P(not A)P(not B).

claims_registry.description: Max-Risk is an uncalibrated ranking heuristic, not a calibrated posterior probability
claims_registry.reproduced_value: Uncalibrated ranking heuristic (merges divergent priors 8.77% vs 2.08%)
claims_registry.explanation: Taking max(P_order, P_listing) destroys posterior calibration. It is effective for queue sorting, but invalid for expected loss modeling.
claims_registry.remediation: Explicitly restrict Max-Risk to ranking use cases.

claims_registry.description: Baseline commit 4615a53602d0a4ffe447d4d2fd14bd69a70bf740 is present in local Git history
claims_registry.explanation: Exact commit hash verified as active HEAD.

claims_registry.description: Generator script SHA-256 equals 0098dad245d724997560c5a5bc4bf70c1bcb98057a4b32d42f85560a4e08bd55
claims_registry.explanation: SHA-256 hash matches disk byte-for-byte.

claims_registry.description: 21-day observation maturity rule excludes orders lacking full observation window before 2026-02-28 23:59:59
claims_registry.explanation: Exact 21-day mathematical difference verified. Orders placed on or after 2026-02-08 are right-censored.

claims_registry.description: Cryptographic commit-reveal process guarantees uncorrupted evaluation
claims_registry.reproduced_value: Prediction hashing proves commitment to bytes, but does not prove uncompromised environment or approved model architecture
claims_registry.explanation: Prediction commitment is necessary but insufficient. Additional operational controls (container hashing, audit execution logs, feature store checksums) are required.
claims_registry.remediation: Specify execution environment hashing in the v2.2 unblinding charter.

discrepancy_register.title: Capacity Constraint Over-Allocation in Stage 3.4
discrepancy_register.detail: Stage 3.4 reported t=0.13 as the 5% capacity operating point (volume 5.76%, 699 orders), exceeding the 606-order ceiling (+93 orders). Corrected threshold is t=0.15 (volume 3.93%, 477 orders, 99 fraud caught).

discrepancy_register.title: In-Sample Evaluation Conflated with Generalization
discrepancy_register.detail: Stage 3.4 reported Validation ECE = 0.0000 without explicitly disclosing that the Isotonic calibrator was evaluated on its own fitting data. Diagnostic test ECE is 0.0282.

discrepancy_register.title: Conflation of Cost-Optimal and 4-Tier Policy Cutoffs
discrepancy_register.detail: Reports mixed terminology between unconstrained cost-optimal cutoff (t=0.07, 424 fraud caught) and 4-tier routing boundary (t=0.08, 422 fraud caught).
